title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2
tagline: Peter and Miles share a larger map, and Venom arrives.
releaseLabel: PlayStation 5: October 20, 2023. A Windows version followed in 2025.
summary: Insomniac’s sequel lets the player switch between Peter Parker and Miles Morales. Kraven hunts the city’s powered people, and the Venom symbiote bonds with Peter. The story stays on Earth-1048.
gameplay: Open-world traversal across New York boroughs, with two playable Spider-Men, symbiote combat for Peter, and co-operative set pieces.
